ruling: ADR_UGENCE_AUTHORITY_PLANE_SCOPING.md AP-5 READS_FIRST (step 3: the front-end shell over the four reads); AP-3 IDP_VALIDATED_FIRST controlling (section 18: AW-1 reversed; no write served before enterprise issuer validation)
notes: This app may consume only the four AP-5 reads the worker serves, and nothing that writes. The worker implements load and revoke behind its identity gate but serves neither until the identity adapter is validated end to end against a real enterprise issuer (AP-3 controlling, section 18); activate and issue act on stores the worker does not compose (AW-2). All four writes are named here as forbidden so none can be added without changing this file and the worker's contract together. scripts/verify-boundary.mjs checks this file against the worker's committed contract and against the client's real call sites, by method.
